title: A clean and simple MP3 tag editor; just what I wanted.
body:
I’ve been looking for a straightforward MP3 tag editor for iPhone, and this is exactly what I wanted. No ads, no subscriptions, no AI trying to guess or “fix” my metadata — just a clean, manual editor that lets me change exactly what I want and nothing else.

The developer was also quick to respond to a question I had, which gave me confidence that the app is actively supported.

If you maintain your own music library and just want a simple, respectful tag editor, I highly recommend TagWeaver.
developer_reply:
Thank you so much for your thoughtful review!

We're delighted to hear that TagWeaver is exactly the kind of tag editor you were looking for. Our goal is to create simple, respectful tools that give users full control over their own metadata—without ads, subscriptions, or AI making changes on their behalf.

Thank you as well for sharing your feedback. Suggestions like yours help us improve TagWeaver, and we're already planning future updates based on user input.

We truly appreciate your support, and we hope TagWeaver continues to be a valuable part of your music library!
